The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, February 5, 2018 Posted by admin on February 5th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Travelers (TRV).  276 points. 
Friday the Dow was down a mere -665.75 (-2.54%) at 25,520.96. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.24%. 
There were zero (0) Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were   Friday were led by Chevron (CVX) -5.57%, Exxon Mobil (XOM) -5.10%, Goldman Sachs (GS) -4.48%, Apple (AAPL) -4.34%, Visa (V) -3.83% and DowDupont (DWDP) -3.55%. 
Bitcoin is back below $8,000. The cryptocurrency was down 6.45% at $7,670 a coin as of 6:24 a.m. ET, trading at its lowest level since the middle of November.
